questions.question: Give three reasons why people store water.
questions.expected_answer: Rain falls only in some seasons and the dry season can last months; droughts happen when there is much less rain than usual; the nearest water source may be far from home; taps can stop when pipes break or pumps fail; water is needed for emergencies such as fires and by farms and factories all year.

questions.question: Name three ways people store water at home and explain how to keep stored water safe.
questions.expected_answer: Clay pots, buckets with lids, drums, jerry cans and rain-water tanks. Keep containers covered and clean, use a clean cup or ladle instead of hands, stop insects and animals getting in, and boil or treat the water if you are not sure it is safe.

questions.question: What is a dam? Give one benefit and one problem of dams.
questions.expected_answer: A dam is a strong wall built across a river to hold back water, which forms a lake behind it. Benefits: it stores water for the dry season and droughts, controls floods, can make electricity and is used for recreation. Problems: it floods farmland, homes and wild places, people may have to move, it blocks fish, and a lot of water evaporates from it.
